title: PLATO Place-Centric Profile
description: A document of one or more SpatialEntities, each with its attestations nested under it: the shape for a dataset of its own places, such as a gazetteer or a converted Linked Places Format file (LPF is PLATO's single-object-attestation profile, and remains valid as it is). Each SpatialEntity carries its own attestations, which do not give an 'about' field: it is implicit from the nesting.

@context.description: The JSON-LD context, so that a JSON-LD processor reads the document as RDF in the PLATO ontology: https://w3id.org/plato/schemas/plato.context.jsonld, or a list or object that includes it. A relative address is allowed, as in JSON-LD; null, which would clear the context, is not. Optional: a tool that knows PLATO applies the context whether or not the document names it.

profile.description: Identifies this as a place-centric document.

@id.description: URI of the gazetteer, if it already exists in the system.

creator.description: The people or organisations to cite as the dataset's authors (dcterms:creator), each with a web address such as an ORCID, a name, or both. Not the same as contributor, the gazetteer's owner.

@id.description: A persistent address for the person or organisation: an ORCID, a ROR.

licence.description: The web address of the dataset's licence (dcterms:license), such as https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Required once status is 'published'.

version.description: The gazetteer's version indicator (dcat:version): '2026-09', '1.4'. A place is cited as its IRI plus this version.

status.description: Publication status (plato:gazetteer_status). Once 'published', the gazetteer's attestations are append-only: never deleted or changed, only superseded or retracted by new ones.

isVersionOf.description: For a frozen snapshot: the living gazetteer it is a version of (dcat:isVersionOf).

previousVersion.description: For a frozen snapshot: the snapshot before it (dcat:previousVersion).

keywords.description: Words a catalogue can find the dataset by (dcat:keyword).

spatial.description: The area the dataset covers, as web addresses (dcterms:spatial): a Wikidata or GeoNames region.

temporal.description: The years the dataset covers (dcterms:temporal, a dcterms:PeriodOfTime).

landingPage.description: The web page where people find and download the dataset (dcat:landingPage).

uriSpace.description: The base from which the dataset's places, sources and other entities have their web addresses (void:uriSpace), e.g. https://w3id.org/whg-epns/. Choose one you control and will keep.

candidateSets.description: The candidate sets made for this dataset (the reverse of plato:candidates_for): the IRIs of the sets whose candidates its identity relations answer through promotedFrom. Each set's own candidatesFor must be this gazetteer's @id, which is therefore required with this key. Optional: a validator given the sets checks that both ends agree.

dataSets.description: The statistical tables the document's figures belong to.

relationTypes.description: Relation types the document declares for its own use, each with the PLATO type it narrows.

spatialEntities.description: The document's SpatialEntities, each with its attestations nested. A SpatialEntity may have no attestations: it is then only a referent, such as the target of a relation, and its label is not evidence.

allOf.description: In place-centric mode, 'about' is implicit (the enclosing SpatialEntity) and should be omitted.

identityRelations.description: Identity assertions whose subject is the enclosing SpatialEntity. 'subject' is implicit from the nesting and may be omitted; if it is given, it must be the enclosing SpatialEntity's @id.
Identity assertions between SpatialEntities in this document, or between them and SpatialEntities elsewhere.

allOf.description: At the top level nothing supplies the subject, so it must be given.
